```{python}
#| label: fig-dft-scan-chain
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Scan design. (a) A scan flip-flop such as `sdfrbpq_1` is a flip-flop with a multiplexer in front: with `SCE` = 0, it loads the functional input `D`, with `SCE` = 1 the scan input `SCD`. (b) The scan flip-flops of a design form a shift register, the scan chain (orange), from `scan_in` through every flip-flop to `scan_out`. One `scan_enable` switches all of them between shifting and normal operation."
#| fig-alt: "Two diagrams. (a) A multiplexer with inputs D at 0 and SCD at 1 and select input SCE drives the D input of a flip-flop clocked by CLK, whose output is Q. A dashed box around both is labeled sdfrbpq_1. (b) A wide green box labeled combinational logic sits above three scan flip-flops FF1, FF2 and FF3. Each flip-flop gets its D input from the logic and returns its output Q to the logic. An orange path runs from the input scan_in into the SCD input of FF1, from the output of FF1 into SCD of FF2, from FF2 into SCD of FF3, and from FF3 to the output scan_out. An orange line scan_enable reaches the SCE inputs of all three, and a red line clk their clock inputs."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow
from schemdraw import elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'
GREEN, GREEN_L = '#82b366', '#d5e8d4'
RED, ORANGE, GREY = '#b85450', '#d79b00', '#666666'


def flop(xl, y, name, pins=('D', 'SCD', 'SCE')):
    ''' Box with three inputs at the left edge xl, returns pins and Q '''
    w, h = 1.8, 2.4
    flow.Box(w=w, h=h).at((xl + w/2, y)).anchor('center').fill(BLUE_L) \
        .color(BLUE)
    ys = [y + 0.75, y + 0.15, y - 0.45]
    for p, yp in zip(pins, ys):
        elm.Label().at((xl + 0.15, yp)).label(p, halign='left', fontsize=9)
    yc = y - 0.95
    flow.Line().at((xl, yc + 0.2)).to((xl + 0.3, yc)).color('black')
    flow.Line().at((xl + 0.3, yc)).to((xl, yc - 0.2)).color('black')
    elm.Label().at((xl + w - 0.2, y + 0.75)).label('Q', halign='right',
                                                   fontsize=9)
    elm.Label().at((xl + w/2, y + h/2 + 0.3)).label(name)
    return [(xl, yp) for yp in ys], (xl, yc), (xl + w, y + 0.75)


def mux(xl, yc):
    ''' Multiplexer with its left edge at xl, returns (in0, in1, sel, out) '''
    h, w = 1.8, 0.8
    pts = [(xl, yc + h/2), (xl + w, yc + h/2 - 0.35),
           (xl + w, yc - h/2 + 0.35), (xl, yc - h/2)]
    for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:] + pts[:1]):
        flow.Line().at(a).to(b).color(GREEN)
    elm.Label().at((xl + 0.25, yc + 0.45)).label('0', fontsize=9)
    elm.Label().at((xl + 0.25, yc - 0.45)).label('1', fontsize=9)
    return (xl, yc + 0.45), (xl, yc - 0.45), (xl + w/2, yc - h/2 + 0.17), \
        (xl + w, yc)


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white', margin=0.2)

    # (a) the scan flip-flop
    elm.Label().at((-0.6, 2.0)).label('(a)', halign='left')
    i0, i1, sel, mo = mux(1.4, 0.0)
    flow.Box(w=1.4, h=2.0).at((3.6 + 0.7, 0.0)).anchor('center') \
        .fill(BLUE_L).color(BLUE)
    elm.Label().at((3.85, 0.45)).label('D', fontsize=9)
    elm.Label().at((4.75, 0.45)).label('Q', fontsize=9)
    flow.Line().at((3.6, -0.35)).to((3.9, -0.55)).color('black')
    flow.Line().at((3.9, -0.55)).to((3.6, -0.75)).color('black')
    flow.Line().at(mo).to((3.0, mo[1]))
    flow.Line().at((3.0, mo[1])).to((3.0, 0.45))
    flow.Arrow().at((3.0, 0.45)).to((3.6, 0.45))
    for name, pin in (('D', i0), ('SCD', i1)):
        elm.Label().at((0.0, pin[1])).label(name, halign='right')
        flow.Arrow().at((0.1, pin[1])).to(pin)
    elm.Label().at((0.0, -1.5)).label('SCE', halign='right')
    flow.Line().at((0.1, -1.5)).to((sel[0], -1.5))
    flow.Arrow().at((sel[0], -1.5)).to(sel)
    elm.Label().at((0.0, -2.1)).label('CLK', halign='right')
    flow.Line().at((0.1, -2.1)).to((3.3, -2.1)).color(RED)
    flow.Line().at((3.3, -2.1)).to((3.3, -0.55)).color(RED)
    flow.Arrow().at((3.3, -0.55)).to((3.6, -0.55)).color(RED)
    flow.Arrow().at((5.0, 0.45)).to((5.8, 0.45))
    elm.Label().at((5.9, 0.45)).label('Q', halign='left')
    flow.Box(w=5.0, h=3.6).at((3.25, -0.2)).anchor('center') \
        .color(GREY).linestyle('--').linewidth(1)
    elm.Label().at((3.25, 1.95)).label('sdfrbpq_1', color=GREY)

    # (b) the scan chain
    x0, y0 = 9.0, -0.6
    elm.Label().at((x0 - 1.4, 2.0)).label('(b)', halign='left')
    flow.Box(w=11.6, h=1.0).at((x0 + 6.6, 2.3)).anchor('center') \
        .fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN).label('combinational logic',
                                          color='black')
    xs = [x0 + 1.4, x0 + 5.4, x0 + 9.4]
    flops = [flop(x, y0, f'FF{k + 1}') for k, x in enumerate(xs)]
    prev = None
    for k, ((pd, ps, pe), pc, q) in enumerate(flops):
        # D from the logic, Q back to the logic
        flow.Line().at((pd[0] - 0.5, 1.8)).to((pd[0] - 0.5, pd[1]))
        flow.Arrow().at((pd[0] - 0.5, pd[1])).to(pd)
        flow.Line().at(q).to((q[0] + 0.5, q[1]))
        flow.Arrow().at((q[0] + 0.5, q[1])).to((q[0] + 0.5, 1.8))
        # the chain
        src = (x0 - 0.2, ps[1]) if prev is None else (prev[0] + 0.5, prev[1])
        if prev is None:
            elm.Label().at((x0 - 0.3, ps[1])).label('scan_in', halign='right',
                                                    color=ORANGE)
            flow.Arrow().at(src).to(ps).color(ORANGE)
        else:
            flow.Line().at(src).to((src[0], ps[1])).color(ORANGE)
            flow.Arrow().at((src[0], ps[1])).to(ps).color(ORANGE)
        prev = q
        # scan enable and clock
        flow.Line().at((pe[0] - 0.5, -2.5)).to((pe[0] - 0.5, pe[1])) \
            .color(ORANGE)
        flow.Arrow().at((pe[0] - 0.5, pe[1])).to(pe).color(ORANGE)
        elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((pe[0] - 0.5, -2.5)).color(ORANGE)
        flow.Line().at((pc[0] - 0.2, -3.1)).to((pc[0] - 0.2, pc[1])) \
            .color(RED)
        flow.Arrow().at((pc[0] - 0.2, pc[1])).to(pc).color(RED)
        elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((pc[0] - 0.2, -3.1)).color(RED)
    flow.Line().at((prev[0] + 0.5, prev[1])).to((prev[0] + 0.5, -1.9)) \
        .color(ORANGE)
    flow.Arrow().at((prev[0] + 0.5, -1.9)).to((prev[0] + 1.6, -1.9)) \
        .color(ORANGE)
    elm.Label().at((prev[0] + 1.7, -1.9)).label('scan_out', halign='left',
                                                color=ORANGE)
    elm.Label().at((x0 - 0.3, -2.5)).label('scan_enable', halign='right',
                                           color=ORANGE)
    flow.Line().at((x0 - 0.2, -2.5)).to((xs[2] - 0.5, -2.5)).color(ORANGE)
    elm.Label().at((x0 - 0.3, -3.1)).label('clk', halign='right')
    flow.Line().at((x0 - 0.2, -3.1)).to((xs[2] - 0.2, -3.1)).color(RED)
```
